limitations: Dependency reachability identifies a conservative source graph, not a symbol-level account of code remaining after linking.
This notice-retention inventory does not replace review of notices embedded only in source comments or document compiler/runtime provenance.

Cargo tree targeted Linux but ran on macOS; harmless Apple host build crates are retained. Linux-host-only rustix -> linux-raw-sys 0.12.1 is explicitly supplemented from exact release locks. Platform-conditioned build dependencies in all retained manifests were inspected.
